title: 第一回期日が開かれました
contents: 2026年6月29日午前11時から、東京地方裁判所103号法廷で、第一回口頭弁論期日が開かれました。原告は、訴状を陳述し、証拠説明書(1)の内容の証拠を提出しました。被告は答弁書を提出しました。これは実質的な中身のないもので、実質答弁は9月15日までに提出されることとなりました。なお、被告から、甲C20の一部について齟齬があると指摘があり、原告で精査の上対応することとなりました。その後、原告妻と原告長男の意見陳述が行われ、また代理人弁護士の高野の訴状弁論が行われました。裁判所からは被告に対し、実質答弁の準備にあたり、身体拘束に関する各要件判断の解釈に当たっては、一般的なよるべき基準があるのか、裁判官の裁量なのかなど、個別の罪証隠滅の思考過程を明確にするよう求められました。最後に次回期日が10月30日午前11時に指定され、期日を終えました。次回期日には原告次男氏の意見陳述が行われる予定です。ぜひ次回期日もお越しください。
contents_en: The first oral argument hearing was held on June 29, 2026, at 11:00 AM in Courtroom 103 of the Tokyo District Court.The plaintiffs submitted their complaint and presented evidence as described in Exhibit Statement (1) .The defendant has submitted a written response . However, this response lacks substance, and a substantive response is due by September 15th.Furthermore, the defendant pointed out some discrepancies regarding a portion of Exhibit C20, and the plaintiff will examine it and take appropriate action.Following this, statements were made by the plaintiff's wife and eldest son , and then the plaintiff's attorney, Takano, presented his arguments in the complaint.The court asked the defendant to clarify the thought process behind the concealment of evidence in each individual case, including whether there are general standards to follow when interpreting the requirements for physical restraint, or whether it is at the judge's discretion, in preparation for the substantive defense.Finally, the next deadline was set for October 30th at 11:00 AM, and the deadline has now passed.The plaintiff's second son is scheduled to give his statement at the next hearing.Please come again on the next date.

title: 目標額達成のお礼
title_en: Thank you for reaching our fundraising goal.
contents: 皆さまのご支援により、目標金額を達成することができました。心より感謝申し上げます。420名近くの方からご寄付をいただき、270名以上の方からあたたかい応援の言葉を頂きました。本当にありがとうございます。2026年6月29日㈪ の第一回期日では原告が訴状の弁論などをする予定です。現時点でご寄付いただいた費用は、専門家への意見書取得など、充実した主張立証活動を行なっていく費用に充てさせていただいております。これから始まる期日では、国内外の専門機関に調査を依頼し、また場合によっては海外の専門家などと連携し、専門的な知見を追加していくことを考えています。そのためにはさらに多くの費用が必要になります。そこで、新たにサードゴールとして500万円を目指したいと思います。どうか引き続きのご支援をお願いいたします。【初回期日決定】2026年6月29日㈪ 11時より、東京地方裁判所103号法廷にて第1回口頭弁論が開かれます。また、期日後には日比谷図書文化館B1ホールにて報告会も予定しておりますので、ぜひ傍聴にお越しいただければ幸いです。※詳細は是非昨日の投稿をご覧ください。
contents_en: Thanks to your generous support, we have successfully reached our fundraising goal. We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has contributed.Nearly 420 people have donated to this campaign, and more than 270 supporters have shared encouraging messages with us. Thank you so much for your kindness and support.The first court hearing is scheduled for 29 June 2026, during which the plaintiffs are expected to present arguments based on the complaint.The funds raised so far are being used to support robust litigation activities, including obtaining expert opinions and reports from specialists.As the case proceeds, we plan to request investigations and analyses from specialist institutions both in Japan and overseas. We are also considering collaborating with international experts to strengthen the evidence and expert knowledge supporting our claims. These efforts will require additional resources.Therefore, we have decided to set a new third fundraising goal of JPY 5 million. We sincerely hope for your continued support as we move forward with this important case.First Hearing ScheduledThe first oral hearing will be held on Monday, 29 June 2026, at 11:00 a.m. in Courtroom 103 of the Tokyo District Court.A post-hearing briefing session is also planned at the B1 Hall of Hibiya Library & Museum following the court proceedings. We would be delighted if you could attend the hearing and join us afterwards. For further details, please see our previous update.

title: 【大川原化工機事件】裁判官の責任を問う訴訟・第1回期日＆報告会のお知らせ
title_en: [Okawara Chemical Machinery Case] Notice of First Hearing and Report Meeting for the Lawsuit Holding Judges Accountable
contents: 【大川原化工機事件】裁判官の責任を問う訴訟の第1回口頭弁論期日が、6月29日（月）11:00から東京地裁103号法廷で開かれます。大川原化工機事件で不当に逮捕・勾留された相嶋静夫さんは、約11カ月間自由を奪われ、保釈が認められないまま、がんで亡くなりました。のちに捜査機関の違法性は認められましたが、逮捕状・勾留状を発付し、保釈を認め続けなかった責任者は裁判官たちです。この訴訟は相嶋さんのご遺族が原告となり、関与した37人の裁判官の判断の違法性を問うことで、日本の刑事司法に法の支配を取り戻し「人質司法」に終止符を打つことを目指しています。第1回口頭弁論期日では、法廷で原告3人が意見陳述を行い、弁護団長の高野隆弁護士が弁論をする予定です。ぜひ傍聴へお越しください。==================================【大川原化工機事件】裁判官の責任を問う訴訟・第1回口頭弁論☑︎日時：2026年6月29日（月） 11:00〜☑︎場所：東京地方裁判所・第103号法廷（東京メトロ霞ヶ関駅A1出口より徒歩1分）※今回の期日は、傍聴希望者が多数集まることが想定されるため、傍聴券交付による抽選になる予定です。開廷30分前ごろまでに地裁入口で配布される傍聴券を受け取り、抽選結果をご確認ください。詳細は裁判所のウェブサイトなども確認ください。==================================期日報告イベント☑︎日時：2026年6月29日（月） 12:15〜13:30☑︎場所：日比谷図書文化館コンベンションホール（東京メトロ霞ヶ関駅B2出口より徒歩約3分）☑︎登壇：青木理さん（ジャーナリスト）、原告、弁護団☑︎内容：第1部では、大川原化工機事件を取材してきたジャーナリストの青木理さんをゲストにお迎えし、人質司法の問題とこの訴訟の意義について、弁護団の谷口太規弁護士と対談するトークセッションを開催。第2部では、原告と弁護団長の高野隆弁護士らが登壇し、今回の期日で行う意見陳述に込めた想いや訴訟の今後の展望についてお伝えします。☑︎参加無料・予約優先：こちらのGoogleフォーム（https://t.co/rAlATGUFoQ）からご予約をお願いします。
contents_en: [Okawara Chemical Machinery Case] The first oral argument hearing in the lawsuit questioning the judge's responsibility will be held on Monday, June 29th at 11:00 AM in Courtroom 103 of the Tokyo District Court.Shizuo Aijima, who was unjustly arrested and detained in the Okawara Chemical Machinery case, was deprived of his freedom for approximately 11 months and died of cancer without ever being granted bail. Although the illegality of the investigative authorities was later recognized, the judges were ultimately responsible for issuing the arrest and detention warrants and for failing to grant bail.This lawsuit, filed by the family of Mr. Aijima, aims to restore the rule of law to Japan's criminal justice system and put an end to "hostage justice" by questioning the illegality of the decisions made by the 37 judges involved.At the first oral argument hearing, the three plaintiffs will present their statements in court, and Attorney Takashi Takano, the head of the legal team, will deliver his arguments. We encourage you to come and observe the proceedings.================================== [Okawara Chemical Machinery Case] Lawsuit to question the judge's responsibility - First oral argument ☑︎Date and time: Monday, June 29, 2026, 11:00 AM☑︎Location: Tokyo District Court, Courtroom No. 103 (1 minute walk from Exit A1 of Kasumigaseki Station on the Tokyo Metro) *Due to the expected large number of people wishing to attend this hearing, a lottery will be held to determine who will be able to attend. Please pick up your admission ticket at the entrance of the district court approximately 30 minutes before the hearing begins and check the lottery results. For further details, please check the court's website .================================== Deadline Reporting Event ☑︎Date and Time: Monday, June 29, 2026, 12:15 PM - 1:30 PM☑︎Location: Hibiya Library and Culture Center Convention Hall (approximately 3 minutes on foot from Exit B2 of Kasumigaseki Station on the Tokyo Metro)☑︎Speakers: Osamu Aoki (journalist), plaintiffs, legal team☑︎Content: In the first part, we will welcome journalist Osamu Aoki, who has covered the Okawara Chemical Machinery case, as a guest for a talk session in which he will discuss the issue of hostage justice and the significance of this lawsuit with lawyer Taiki Taniguchi of the legal team.In the second part, the plaintiffs and the head of the legal team, attorney Takashi Takano, will take the stage to share their thoughts behind the statements they will make at this hearing and their outlook for the future of the lawsuit.☑︎Participation is free, but reservations are prioritized . Please make your reservation using this Google Form (https://t.co/rAlATGUFoQ).

title: 第一回期日が決まりました
title_en: The date for the first session has been set.
contents: 第一回期日が、2026年6月29日（月）11時からに決まりました。期日の内容等は追ってお知らせいたします。また、期日後に報告会を予定していますので、そちらにつきましても詳細が決まりましたら改めてご連絡いたします。どうぞご参加いただければ幸いです。
contents_en: The date for the first session has been set for Monday, June 29, 2026, at 11:00 AM. Details regarding the date and other information will be announced later. We also have a debriefing session planned after the deadline, and we will contact you again with details once they are finalized. We would be delighted if you could participate.

title: 目標金額を増額いたしました
contents: 本日提訴した本訴訟は、おかげさまで当初のクラウドファンディングの目標額（100万円）を達成できました。それにより、50万を超える印紙代や提訴までの交通費等を賄うことができました。本当にありがとうございます。このたびセカンドチャレンジとして、ネクストゴール（300万円）を設定いたしました。ご寄付は主に、専門家への意見書取得など、訴訟にて充実した主張立証活動を行なっていく費用に充てる予定です。静夫さんの身体拘束を続けた裁判官の判断過程はどのようなものであったか、何とか訴訟を通じて明らかにし、その責任を追及してまいりたいと思います。人質司法を終わらせ､二度と今回のような悲劇が生まれないよう、何卒お力添えを賜れれば幸甚です。
contents_en: Thanks to your generous support, the lawsuit we filed today has successfully reached its initial crowdfunding goal of JPY 1,000,000. This has enabled us to cover essential costs such as court filing fees exceeding JPY 500,000, as well as transportation expenses related to filing the case. We are truly grateful for your support.As a second challenge, we have now set a new target of JPY 3,000,000. The additional funds will primarily be used to strengthen our litigation efforts, including obtaining expert opinions and further substantiating our legal arguments.Through this lawsuit, we aim to shed light on the decision-making process of the judges who continued to impose physical detention on Mr. Shizuo, and to hold those responsible accountable. We are committed to ending Japan’s “Hostage Justice” system and preventing such tragedies from ever happening again. We would be deeply grateful for your continued support.

title: 提訴のお知らせ
contents: 2026年4月6日、東京地方裁判所に提訴いたしました。本訴訟の概要については、基本情報ページに加え、本日提訴にあわせて公表した「提訴のお知らせ」をご覧ください。訴状はこちらから、要約版はこちらからご覧いただけます。今後、裁判所から初回期日の指定があり次第、本ページにてお知らせいたします。ご支援のほどよろしくお願いいたします。
contents_en: On April 6, 2026, we filed a lawsuit with the Tokyo District Court. For an overview of this lawsuit, please refer to the basic information page, as well as the " Notice of Lawsuit Filing " which was published today in conjunction with the filing of the lawsuit. You can view the full complaint here , and a summary version here . We will post an update on this page as soon as the court sets the date for the first hearing. Your support would be greatly appreciated.
